evals.name: configure-existing
evals.prompt: tenho um projeto laravel aqui em ./meu-projeto que acabei de criar, ainda tá cru. aplica o setup padrão nele: análise estática, code style, os scripts de qualidade, tudo. é um projeto interno, em inglês mesmo.
evals.expected_output: phpstan.neon + pint.json written, dev deps installed, composer scripts stan/pint/coverage/coverage-html/quality merged into composer.json without losing the existing ones, pt_BR NOT applied (user said English), composer stan and composer pint both run clean.
assertions: Laravel's pre-existing composer scripts survived the merge
composer stan runs clean on the configured project
pt_BR was NOT applied (user asked for English / did not ask for it)

evals.name: new-project-ptbr
evals.prompt: cria um projeto laravel novo chamado catalogo nessa pasta e já deixa ele com todo o meu setup padrão. é pra um cliente brasileiro, o sistema vai ser todo em português.
evals.expected_output: New Laravel app at ./catalogo with the full toolchain applied AND pt_BR: lang/pt_BR published, APP_LOCALE=pt_BR in .env and .env.example, the localization package removed from composer.json, laravel/framework intact, composer stan passes.
assertions: Laravel's pre-existing composer scripts survived the merge
composer stan runs clean on the configured project
localization package removed from composer.json after publishing

evals.name: extend-skill
evals.prompt: quero mudar meu setup padrão de laravel: adiciona o pest nas dependências de dev e tira o debugbar, e cria um passo novo que instala e configura o laravel/sail. depois aplica o setup atualizado no ./meu-projeto.
evals.expected_output: The SKILL's own config is edited (assets/dev-packages.txt gains pestphp/pest, loses fruitcake/laravel-debugbar) and a new module file is added under modules/ following the template contract — not a one-off hand edit of the project. Then the updated setup runs on ./meu-projeto.
assertions: Laravel's pre-existing composer scripts survived the merge
composer stan runs clean on the configured project
pt_BR was NOT applied (user asked for English / did not ask for it)
skill asset dev-packages.txt no longer lists debugbar
a new module file for Sail was added under modules/
the new module declares the name/desc headers the runner reads
debugbar not installed in the project
